contract.confirmation_record: 创建时记录状态/模式/时间；状态变化追加 previous_status 和 status_changed_at；PPT 追加 generation_status
contract.source_resolution: 项目目录中的 asset_version_id 才进入 V#；无法映射的全局文件保留 source_refs.status=unresolved
contract.presentation_binding: 当前项目生成 PPT 时建立项目 artifact，完成后回写 task_id、output_path、renderer、证据覆盖和来源解析结果
contract.side_effect_boundary: 邮件/日程仍为本地草稿；邮件发送和日历导出继续要求 confirmed；PPT 的 WPS 打开请求单独记录

verification.frontend_build: npm run build passed; existing bundle-size warning retained
coverage: legacy artifacts table migration backfills confirmation_record
artifact status change keeps previous status and timestamp
email attachment source refs resolve only inside the selected project
schedule and email draft plans store confirmation and change summary
completed project PPT binds asset_version_id, task result, plan and output provenance

interpretation: This increment proves the three existing local artifact paths persist the requested provenance fields and that project-bound PPT completion can be traced to catalog asset versions. It does not prove semantic fact-level citation validity, because unresolved global documents and cross-Playbook answer facts still require separate E#/V#/A#/M# validation.
limitations: PPT generation through a legacy unscoped tool call without project_id cannot create a project artifact; the UI now requires a selected project.
Global documents without a project_catalog asset version remain explicitly unresolved rather than receiving a fabricated version ID.
No user-authored Playbook editor or version migration is implemented.
No sealed-test data, RAG ranking weight, model, or external send/calendar behavior was changed.
